spoken_summary: An interviewer asks Vice President Kamala Harris for her favorite song of all time. Harris responds that she has a wide range of tastes, mentioning she recently bought records by jazz artist Charles Mingus and funk/soul artist Roy Ayers. She concludes by stating, 'But I'm a hip-hop kid — that's how I grew up.'

central_claim: Vice President Kamala Harris has a cool and diverse musical taste, encompassing both classic jazz and hip-hop, making her relatable.
